fact: The Democratic Affairs Standing Committee of the House held a hearing on the draft Freedom of Information Proclamation on 27 April 2026, with the Chief Ombudsman presenting it and the Ombudsman named to monitor its implementation.
title: የመረጃ ነጻነት ረቂቅ አዋጅ በዕድገት ጉዞ ውስጥ ግልጽነት፣ ተጠያቂነትና ኃላፊነት እንዲሰፍን ያስችላል
